critic_output.summary: The majority of the proposed squad has no fresh injury, suspension, transfer or rotation red flags in the last 1-2 weeks and looks available as expected. The clearest concern is Noah Okafor, whose minutes are being actively managed by Leeds as he builds fitness. No other players in the list currently show equivalent issues around availability or expected role this round.
